objective: Make the production go/no-go decision for RepoTracer Scout using functional public-task outcomes, representative multi-round work, routing behavior, citations, timeout reliability, complete cost, and wall time.

selected_system.selection_basis: The 48-trial tier pilot requested priority for the fast arm, but all 155 successful non-guardian Luna requests reported actual_service_tier=default. The service-tier exposure was not established, so the preregistered tie rule keeps default.

formal_lane.corpus: DeepSWE public task and hidden-verifier artifacts from deep-swe-1-1
formal_lane.selection: Thirty unique tasks from thirty unique repositories, sampled before model execution with seed 20260830 and language quotas TypeScript 9, Python 9, Go 9, Rust 2, JavaScript 1.

arms.repotracer: Same parent with RepoTracer MCP and the current production routing policy.

formal_lane.verifier: Pinned task Dockerfile and test.sh, linux/amd64, no network, two CPUs, 8 GiB, 1800-second cap. The agent never sees verifier files.
secondary_outcomes: paired task-level pass wins and losses

mah_swe_lane.session_policy: Round two resumes the exact round-one Codex thread and working tree.
mah_swe_lane.manual_review: Inspect every final patch, both final answers, both trajectories, test logs, Scout calls, and citations. Score requirements and maintainability 0-4 after functional checks.

billing.parent: Exact codex-lb request-log totals for each parent conversation.
billing.scout: Per-call uncached input at $0.20/M, cached input at $0.02/M, and output including reasoning at $1.20/M from returned Scout usage.
billing.complete: Parent cost plus every Scout-call estimate.
billing.warning: Never call parent-only cost complete. Report guardian, failed, and zero-output request rows where present.

decision_gates.quality: Candidate verified pass rate may be at most 5 percentage points below baseline, with paired pass wins not fewer than paired pass losses.
decision_gates.economics: Candidate median complete cost must not exceed baseline median complete cost.
decision_gates.latency: Candidate median wall time may be at most 20% slower than baseline.
decision_gates.reliability: Candidate may not add more than two model timeouts or nonzero exits across 90 formal trials, and all MAH-SWE required checks must pass in at least as many candidate as baseline repeats.
decision_gates.citations: Every citation returned by successful Scout calls must name an existing source file and valid line range.
decision_gates.representative_work: Candidate MAH-SWE manual score may be at most 0.25/4 below baseline and may not introduce a repeated requirement-boundary failure.
decision_gates.go: Ship RepoTracer only if every floor passes. Otherwise retain the parent-only baseline and name the failed gate.

failure_policy.infrastructure: A source, Docker, billing-store, or subscription infrastructure failure invalidates and reruns the complete matched pair.
failure_policy.model: Timeout, nonzero exit, malformed output, bad patch, missing citation, or verifier failure remains a scored outcome.
failure_policy.retention: Keep every losing, failed, and invalidated attempt in ignored private artifacts. Never rewrite a completed valid trial.
